items.title: 1.10 Wi-Fi security aur router configuration (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu of topic 1.10 (PDF 17), paragraph for paragraph, with a password tip, two self-checks and a recap.

blocks.text: Wi-Fi security network ko be-ijazat (unauthorized) istemal se bachati hai. Security ke baghair koi bhi aap ka Internet istemal kar sakta hai. Hackers ghair-mehfooz networks se zaati maloomat chura sakte hain. Mehfooz Wi-Fi data ko mehfooz aur raaz mein rakhta hai. Yeh Internet ko sust hone se bhi bachata hai. Mazboot security poore network ki performance behtar karti hai.

items: Router Configuration: router ka web interface router ki settings sambhalne ke liye istemal hota hai. Yeh web browser mein khulta hai. User router ka IP address likh kar is tak pohanchta hai. Login ke liye username aur password chahiye. Is interface se Wi-Fi ka naam aur password badla ja sakta hai. Yeh security settings control karne mein bhi madad deta hai.

Wi-Fi Encryption: network par bheje gaye data ki hifazat karti hai. Yeh data ko mehfooz (khufia) shakal mein badal deti hai. WPA2 aur WPA3 aam security protocols hain. WEP jaise purane protocols mehfooz nahi. Mazboot encryption data ki chori rokti hai. Users ko hamesha sab se naya encryption tareeqa chunna chahiye.

Default Gateway: default gateway local network ko doosre networks se jorta hai. Aam taur par yeh router hota hai. Jo data bahar ke networks ke liye ho, woh gateway se guzarta hai. Gateway data ko sahi network ki taraf aage bhejta hai. Internet tak pohanch isi par munhasir hai. Gateway ki sahi setting zaroori hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Aath (8) characters ka ek mazboot namoona password banayein jis mein huroof (letters) aur numbers dono hon (alpha-numeric).

blocks.title: Lambe passwords zyada mazboot hain
blocks.text: Kitab ki activity aath characters kehti hai. Aaj kal ki rehnumai is se lambe password ya passphrase, taqreeban 12 ya zyada characters, pasand karti hai, jin mein chhote bare huroof, numbers aur symbols mile hon; aur router ka default password kabhi waisa hi na chhorein.

Guest network mehmanon ko Internet istemal karne deta hai. Yeh ghar ke asal network se alag hota hai. Guest users zaati devices tak nahi pohanch sakte. Is se network ki hifazat aur raazdari (privacy) barhti hai. Guest networks Internet ke istemal ko control karne mein madad dete hain. Yeh gharon aur daftaron mein faidemand hain.

blocks.prompt: WEP ke bajaye WPA2 ya WPA3 kyun chunna chahiye?
blocks.explanation: WEP purana protocol hai jo ab mehfooz nahi; WPA2 aur WPA3 mazboot encryption use karte hain, is liye Wi-Fi par bheja data asani se churaya nahi ja sakta.
Woh device (aam taur par router) jis ke zariye local network doosre networks, jaise Internet, ko data bhejta hai.

items: Wi-Fi security be-ijazat istemal aur data ki chori rokti hai.
Router web interface: browser mein router ka IP address; Wi-Fi naam, password aur security settings.
WPA2/WPA3 istemal karein, WEP nahi; default gateway (aam taur par router) bahar ke networks tak; mehmanon ke liye guest network.
